description: Query one bounded page per account of Ads Insights for one account or 2 to 5 accountIds, with table rows by default. Use friendly metrics such as leads, purchases and roas for business questions. Omitted counts and values are 0 with delivery (impressions > 0) and null otherwise; a positive count without an action value stays null. Native result indicators with empty values are 0 on delivered rows; cost per result stays null for zero results. Use results and cost_per_result to assess optimization goals at campaign, ad set or ad level. Missing native results can be derived from ad set setup and delivery; incomplete data stays unknown. Discover fields by search or group. Asset breakdowns analyze flexible or dynamic creative ads; use each alone. For audience segment mix (prospecting / engaged / existing customers) use breakdowns: [user_segment_key] alone, with timeIncrement weekly or monthly for share of spend over time. Request only needed columns and use paging.after to continue only when needed. Reach, frequency, and CTR are non-additive, so never sum them across rows. Empty rows are successful. Zero-impression rows are excluded by default (excludeZeroImpressions: true); set false to include zero rows. Compare keeps a row if either period has impressions above zero, including drops to zero. Use compare for vs last period or previous-year questions. Requested fields stay visible; friendly formulas are evaluated per period and native result values match by indicator and attribution window. Uncomparable fields retain current values with COMPARE_FIELD_UNSUPPORTED listing the fields. Use include for status, budget, targeting or creative context instead of separate list calls. Targeting geo includes countries; country_groups with key/label (eea = European Economic Area (EEA)); region and geo-market names; cities with radius/unit; zip/custom-location samples; location_types; and the same fields under geo.excluded. Each list is capped at 25 with full singular counts (country_count, country_group_count, region_count, city_count, geo_market_count, zip_count, custom_location_count, location_type_count) and truncated: true on its container when capped. Additional geo dimensions are retained. flexible_spec groups contain capped interest, behavior and demographic names with per-list counts and flexible_spec_count. Custom audience lists are capped and counted. Use accountIds for cross-account views; never add totals across accounts. Account-level cell estimates use one row per account without breakdowns or time buckets, then multiply bounded buckets/breakdowns and cap by limit. Multi-account pages use paging.byAccount and an after cursor map; set completed accounts to null. A status: pending result means call ads_get_insights_job with job.id; never re-run the query to check progress. Cached results carry meta.cache.ageSeconds; fresh skips the cache read. On 429, report the Retry-After wait and do not retry in a loop. Reporting 429 responses carry Retry-After. ROW_QUOTA_EXCEEDED means wait until meta.quota.resetsAt (or the error quota reset); do not retry before then.

accountId.description: Ad account ID used for the X-Ad-Account header, e.g. act_123. It is not sent in the Insights request body.

accountIds.description: 2 to 5 distinct accounts instead of accountId. Sequential, synchronous pages with each account currency and timezone. Never add totals across accounts.

actionBreakdowns.description: Defaults to action_type. Other dimensions produce actionRows/actionColumns and cannot be used with friendly metrics. action_type is always included.

actionTypes.description: Optional Meta action_type values used to select and flatten action-family fields such as actions or cost_per_action_type.

after.description: Single-account opaque cursor, or account-to-cursor map for accountIds. Use canonical act_ IDs. Omit an account for its first page; null marks an exhausted account. Keep the query unchanged.

attribution.description: Attribution controls echoed in response.meta. Omit this object to follow the account setting.

reportTime.description: Time basis for attributed actions. Omit it to use Meta's default reporting behavior.

useAccountSetting.description: Use the ad account attribution setting. Defaults to true and cannot be true when explicit windows are supplied.

windows.description: Explicit Meta action attribution windows. Supplying windows selects explicit attribution instead of the account setting.

breakdowns.description: At most two breakdowns. Asset, media and hourly breakdowns must each be used alone. Use asset breakdowns for flexible/dynamic creative. user_segment_key = audience segment (prospecting / engaged / existing customers); use alone.

compare.description: Use for vs last period comparisons. Requires all_days and sync execution; maximum/data_maximum and non-default actionBreakdowns are unsupported. Previous values and changes appear beside each numeric metric; null means unavailable.

since.description: Inclusive range start in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the ad account timezone.

until.description: Inclusive range end in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the ad account timezone.

datePreset.description: Named Meta date preset. Mutually exclusive with timeRange. Defaults to last_30d when neither date option is supplied.

excludeZeroImpressions.description: Defaults to true: drops zero-impression rows (adds impressions > 0 to Meta filtering). Set false to include them. Compare keeps a row if either period has impressions.

fields.description: Friendly business metrics or native fields. Use results/cost_per_result for optimization goals at campaign, ad set or ad level; missing native results can be derived from ad set setup and delivery. Discover with search/group. Custom conversions use custom_conversion.<id>, custom_conversion_value.<id>, cost_per_custom_conversion.<id>.

filters.description: Optional entity ID filters. Use the filter matching the IDs you already know.

adIds.description: Ad IDs included in the result. IDs are matched with Meta's IN filter.

adSetIds.description: Ad set IDs included in the result. IDs are matched with Meta's IN filter.

campaignIds.description: Campaign IDs included in the result. IDs are matched with Meta's IN filter.

format.description: table returns row arrays in column order, including actionRows. objects returns keyed rows.

fresh.description: Skip the cache read but still cache the refreshed result.

include.description: Use for status, budget or creative context instead of separate list calls. Separate entities maps are linked to rows by meta.entityRefs, with summaries for targeting and creative assets. Defaults to 10 rows when include is set and limit is omitted (25 otherwise). Explicit limits are unchanged.

level.description: Entity level for each result row. Defaults to account.

limit.description: Maximum rows in this one bounded Meta page. Reduce it when a wide result approaches the MCP output budget. Defaults to 10 rows when include is set and limit is omitted (25 otherwise). Explicit limits are unchanged.

mode.description: auto uses async for heavy queries. sync caps daily ranges at 90 days; async supports up to 400.

field.description: One requested native scalar field to sort by. Action-family fields cannot be sorted.

timeIncrement.description: Time bucketing for rows. all_days returns one aggregate bucket; daily is limited to 90 days in sync mode or 400 in auto/async mode.

timeRange.description: Explicit current date range, mutually exclusive with datePreset. Use compare for a previous period, previous year or custom range.

since.description: Inclusive range start in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the ad account timezone.

until.description: Inclusive range end in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the ad account timezone.

where.description: Numeric comparisons, string name filters, status in/not_in, or objective in. Values are numbers for metrics, strings for names, arrays for in/not_in.
